changes.how: Step 1.8 creates this script (the twin of scripts/ratchet.mjs for src/server/route-load.baseline.json, over routeLoadCounts() and ENTRIES in scripts/lib/route-load.mjs, walking with scripts/lib/import-walk.mjs). Add a switch --trace-lists that, with the walker of scripts/lib/import-walk.mjs following static AND dynamic imports (reach(SRC, entry, { dynamic: true })), walks every route entry under src/app (each page.tsx and route.ts, together with every layout.tsx, template.tsx, loading.tsx, error.tsx and not-found.tsx in the folders above it up to src/app, and default.tsx of parallel routes) plus src/proxy.ts and src/instrumentation.ts, and writes src/data/trace-free-routes.json: { taxonomyFree: [route keys], sharpFree: [route keys] }, each sorted. A route is taxonomyFree when none of its files reaches src/server/product-taxonomy.ts; sharpFree when none reaches an import of the package 'sharp' (static or import('sharp')). A route key is the route as Next names it in .next/app-path-routes-manifest.json: the folder path under src/app with route groups '(name)' and parallel slots '@name' removed and '/page' or '/route' cut (src/app/api/health/route.ts is '/api/health'; 'src/app/s/[store]/[market]/page.tsx' is '/s/[store]/[market]'). Then make each list safe for the way Next matches a key: Next builds a route's name with normalizeAppPath() of its entry ('app/api/health/route' becomes '/app/api/health') and tests every key with picomatch's option contains: true, which matches the key ANYWHERE in that name (checked on 12 November: the key '/api/health' also matches '/app/api/health/x', and '/' matches every route). So: the key of a route is escaped('/app' + routeKey) (for '/' that is '/app', which every route contains); drop from each list every route whose '/app' + routeKey is a substring of '/app' + the key of any route NOT on that list (for example '/s/[store]/[market]' can never be listed while '/s/[store]/[market]/p/[handle]' needs the files), and print the dropped ones. Leave src/proxy.ts and src/instrumentation.ts in the walk's output under the keys 'middleware' and 'instrumentation' (the names their traces have in .next/server; confirm with ls .next/server/*.nft.json after a build) and drop them from the lists if their traces still hold the files after the build. ['./src/data/product-taxonomy/*'] : []), ...(traceFree.sharpFree.includes(route) ? SHARP_FILES : [])]])). The key form is settled: Next names an app route '/app' + its path without groups (normalizeAppPath) and matches keys with picomatch contains: true, so a key is a substring test and the script only lists routes whose key is no substring of a route that needs the files. migration.notes: Generated by pnpm db:generate from src/db/schema.ts: alter table commerce.products add column standard_shown jsonb (nullable, no default). commerce.products is a hot table, but the hot-table rule is about indexes (built concurrently in a '-- kaizen:no-transaction' file) and constraints (added not valid): this change adds neither. Adding a nullable column without a default does not rewrite the table and holds its lock for an instant, within the 5 s lock wait. Add only, so the running code keeps working until the deploy finishes: old code never names the column, and every insert into products names its columns. No backfill in SQL: the dispatcher's job fills rows after the deploy. CI's release job applies the file; never by hand. After the deploy check the advisors and record the version in the decision row.
